summary: Aeva Technologies, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for an underwritten follow-on offering of 4,494,382 shares of common stock at $22.25 per share, raising $100M gross ($95M net after underwriting discounts). The shares trade on Nasdaq under AEVA; last sale $25.31 on June 3, 2026. Underwriters include Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, and Oppenheimer. This is a routine capital raising transaction (traditional shelf takedown), not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or activist campaign. No special-situation elements are present.
